stem: If a₁, a₂, …, aₙ are in H.P., then the expression a₁a₂ + a₂a₃ + … + aₙ₋₁aₙ is equal to (a) n(a₁ − aₙ) (b) (n − 1)(a₁ − aₙ) (c) na₁aₙ (d) (n − 1)a₁aₙ [JEE Main 2006]

If in a triangle ABC the altitudes from the vertices A, B, C on the opposite sides are in H.P., then sin A, sin B, sin C are in (a) G.P. (b) Arithmetic–Geometric Progression (c) H.P. (d) A.P. [JEE Main 2005]
Let a₁, a₂, a₃, … be in harmonic progression with a₁ = 5 and a₂₀ = 25. The least positive integer n for which aₙ < 0 is (a) 25 (b) 22 (c) 23 (d) 24 [JEE Advanced 2012 (Paper 2)]
